verification.note: Reproduced by reading the code. labels.ts is changed by this branch (it is listed in r1/product-files.txt) and is not a touch point. At HEAD, VideoShelfPage.tsx:201 passes `shelf: { key: shelfKey, label: "" }`. The checkout at /Users/libre/Sources/video_share, which predates this branch, has `label: shelfKey` at VideoShelfPage.tsx:177. labels.ts:41 (`by === "tag"`) returns `shelf.label` for every key except no_tag, so it now returns "". VideoAppHeader.tsx:49 uses `title ?? t("title")`, and `??` keeps the empty string, so a Video by=tag See all page has an empty title. It looks like the folder branch was reordered to prefer `shelf.label` (labels.ts:37); without the label change, a See all page would have shown the full folder path, so the label was blanked and that broke the tag branch. No VideoShelfPage test uses by=tag.

ToolbarMenu.tsx is in r1/product-files.txt and is not a touch point. It adds `inlineLabel` (lines 140, 174, 256-262) and `onOpenChange` (lines 157, 181). `changeOpen` (lines 188-191) now handles the trigger toggle (line 220) and `close` (line 194, used by Escape at 211 and DismissScrim at 288). FilterMenus.tsx:217/222/231 are the only callers of the new props. No test under components/__tests__ refers to inlineLabel or onOpenChange on ToolbarMenu.

VideoPagedGrid.tsx is in r1/product-files.txt and is not a touch point. It adds a `filtered` prop (lines 49, 53) and separates the `empty` branch (line 58) from the `ready && items.length === 0` branch (lines 61-66), which shows appFilters.filterEmpty when `filtered` is set. VideoShelfPage.tsx:248 calls it without `filtered`.

useReadingApp.ts:269-271 adds `useEffect(() => { readLibraryFilters("reading", drive) }, [drive])`, and chooseTarget at :278 calls `resetLibraryFilters("reading", drive)`. useReadingApp.ts is in r1/product-files.txt. readingapp/ReadingApp.tsx is not in that list, so the branch does not change it.

frontend/src/test/setup.ts:5 imports resetLibraryFilters, and :151-152 reset video and reading with drive "". popup-dismissal.test.ts:171 has the key frontend/src/components/appshell/FilterMenus.tsx. e2e-components/projects.ts:10 and spec-viewport.spec.ts:82,101 register library-filters(-desktop).spec.ts. All of these files are in r1/product-files.txt or r1/test-files.txt, and none is a touch point.

At HEAD, clipsAppHarness.tsx:151-158 has `(!q(c).has("trust") || q(c).get("per_shelf") === "60")`. The pre-branch harness (video_share checkout, line 151) had `!q(c).has("trust")`. A by=all shelves call with trust and per_shelf=60 therefore now matches isNewShelf. The comment at :155-156 says Home's New shelf is the call without trust, but the predicate also matches the Library's per_shelf=60 grid. Callers in clipsLibrary/clipsLibraryFilters/clipsViewPerTarget add `per_shelf === "60"` themselves. The Home assertions at clipsHome.test.tsx:137 and :206 now also match any trust-carrying per_shelf=60 call.
